overview: Installs and configures prometheus-node-exporter for Prometheus scraping. Prompts for listen address and port — useful on any server you want to monitor.
prerequisites: Prometheus or monitor-host configured to scrape this target
Firewall allows scrape port from monitoring server

steps.title: Install the package
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-node-exporter

steps.title: Configure and start
steps.body: Prompts for listen address (e.g. 0.0.0.0 or private IP) and port.

steps.title: Verify
steps.command:
sudo himosoft-node-exporter status
curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | head

notes: Install on Server A, B, and C for full fleet monitoring
